verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents multiple concrete speed/latency features: Fast serverless variants for latency-sensitive workloads, on-demand dedicated GPUs for lower latency/higher throughput, speculative decoding to cut generation latency, quantization to boost performance, sticky-routing for prompt-cache hits, reserved throughput for guaranteed capacity, and an open-source benchmarking tool to measure throughput/latency. This directly addresses both time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation needs. missing for 10: independent/third-party latency benchmarks corroborating these claims (only vendor docs provided), and the one community datapoint present is about fine-tuning cost, not latency/throughput performance.
